book.name: Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela
book.title: Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela Pa Pataŋani Toozi (Kisim Bek—Eksodus)

content: Maaron ipariaaŋ saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tooni muul

Tauvene Yoova isaav pa Mose ighe: “Aazne, yo aat ughit katin ŋgar tau yau pale nagham pa kinik to Isip. Yau pale natotoi tapirig tiina pani, leso ipul yes Israela tila. I pale ighit katin yau tapirig le isov, o iziir gham aghau pa nugh tooni.”
Ve Maaron isaav pa Mose muul ighe: “Yau Yoova nalepleep.
Muuŋ, saawe tau navot to Abaram, Isak, ve Yakop, navotia taug pazi naghe: Yau Maaron Saksaki Tau Naliiv Zimaronŋa Tisov. Eemon ezag Yoova, ene navotia pazi mako.
Ve nambu saveeŋ tomani zi naghe yeŋa pale nivalupu ghei nimin eemon, ve nagham taan to yes Kanaana tau tileep timin loom pani na, imin lezi motot.
“Aazne, yes Israela titaŋ tiina pasaa, yes Isipa tighamgham saghatin zi, ve tighurghur pataŋani naol pazi. Eemon taŋiiz toozi, yau nalooŋa wa. Ve matag iŋgalŋgal saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tsiau.

“Tauvene yo aat ula ve uvotia aliŋag pa yes Israela ughe: ‘Yau Yoova nalepleep. Aazne, yam amin besooŋa pa yes Isipa, ve tapirizi itatan gham le lemim eez eta mako. Eemon yau aat nagham gabua ŋgeretazi tintiina siriv, leso nagham mulin gham ila yes Isipa nimazi. Pale natotoi tapirig tiina ivot ighazooŋ, ve naghur atuya iŋarui zi pa sosor toozi. Leso napas gham avot pa pataŋani tsiam.

Ve yau pale nagham gham amin tamtamon tsiau, ve yau Yoova namin Maaron tsiam. Ve yam pale awatagh katin ghau, ve aghazooŋ pa gabuag tomania ŋgar tsiau. Pasaa, uraat tau naghe nagham payam, ene pale ipaghazoŋai ŋgar tsiam payau. Onoon, aazne yes Isipa tapirizi itatan gham. Eemon yau aat nagham mulin gham ila nimazi, ve nagharaat eez payam, leso apul nugh toozi ve ala.

Muuŋ, yau nambu saveeŋ ve napariaaŋa le iyaryaaŋ kat naghe nagham taan to yes Kanaana pa Abaram, Isak, ve Yakop imin lezi motot. Tauvene yau pale nagham gham ala avot taan tawe, ve naghamu imin lemim kat, leso aleep pani taghon taghon gha ila. Pasaa, yau Yoova nalepleep.’”

Yoova isavia saveeŋ tane le isov, ra Mose ila ipaesia Yoova aliiŋa pa yes Israela. Eemon uraat pataŋani tau yes tighamghamu na, ene itatan zi le tapirizi isov kat. Tauvene lolozi pa loŋaaŋ saveeŋ tooni mako.
Ra Yoova isaav pa Mose muul ighe: “Ula ughita kinik to Isip, ve usaav pani to iyok pa yes Israela, leso tipul taan tooni ve tila.”
Eemon Mose iyol Yoova aliiŋa ighe: “Yau ŋeer to savsaveeŋ mako. Isaav ighe yes Israela tilooŋ saveeŋ tsiau mako, ene pale kinik paam, irau ilooŋ ghau mako.”
Ra Yoova isaav pa Mose gha Aron ighe timuul tila to yes Israela ve kinik to Isip. Ve ighur uraat pa yesuru ighe tigham yes Israela tipul Isip ve tila.
Pitiiŋ to Mose yesuru Aron
Ene pitiiŋ to yes Israela timbuzŋa siriv. Yakop naatu aidaaba eeza Ruben. Ve Ruben natŋa, ene: Anok, Palu, Ezron, ve Karmi. Yes tana tivot timin eval, ve murei ra, tivalagh tauzi timin rumei paaŋ.

Yakop naatu Simeon natŋa, ene: Yemuel, Yamin, Oat, Yakin, Zoar, ve Saul. (Saul tiina, i Kanaan tinazi.) Yes tana ta tivot ila to Simeon le timin eval, ve murei ra, tivalagh tauzi timin rumei liim ve ee.
Yakop naatu Levi natŋa ezazi, ene: Gerson, Koat, ve Merari. Levi ileep irau ndaman 137, ra imaat.
Gerson natŋa, ene: Libni ve Simei.
Koat natŋa, ene: Amram, Izar, Ebron, ve Usiel. Koat ileep irau ndaman 133, ra imaat.
Merari natŋa, ene: Mali gha Musi. Yes tana ta tivot ila to Levi le timin eval, ve murei ra, tivalagh tauzi timin rumei rumei.
Amram ivai waghliva Yokopet. Ve Yokopet ipoop Aron yesuru Mose. Amram ileep irau ndaman 137, ra imaat.
Izar natŋa, ene: Kora, Nepek, ve Zikri.
Ve Usiel natŋa, ene: Misael, Elzapan, ve Sitri.
Aron ivai Eliseba tau Aminadap natliva, i Nason liivu. Eliseba yesuru Aron tipoop paaŋ: Nadap, Abiu, Eleasar, ve Itamar.
Kora natŋa, ene: Asir, Elkana, ve Abiasap. Kora natŋa tol tana tivot timin eval, ve murei ra, tivalagh tauzi timin rumei tol.
Aron naatu Eleasar ivai Putiel natliva, ve tipoop Pineas. Yes tane ta Levi paaghu tooni, ve timin daaba pa rumei toz toz.

Ene Aron yesuru Mose puughu toozi. Yoova ighur yesuru to timuuŋ pa yes Israela, ve tigham zi tipul Isip, ve tilaagh ila ŋgun ŋgun itaghon rumei toz toz, ve tila pa taan Kanaan. Ve yesuru, ta tisaav pa kinik to Isip tighe i iyok pazi leso tigham yes Israela tipul nugh Isip ve tila.
Saawe tau Mose ilepleep izi taan Isip, Yoova isaav pani ighe: “Yau Yoova nalepleep. Saveeŋ isov tau yau nasavia payo na, yo aat usavia pa kinik to yes Isipa leso ilooŋa.”
Eemon Mose isaav pa Yoova ighe: “Yau ŋeer to savsaveeŋ mako. Pale kinik ilooŋ ghau mindai?”
